properties.notes: Redevelopment could provide around 3,000sqm of additional floorspace, an element of which could include housing. The Council’s preferred approach is a mix of uses with a retail frontage on Tottenham Court Road and provision of permanent self-contained housing, including an appropriate contribution to affordable housing. Any additional non-residential floorspace should be matched by an equal addition to floorspace for permanent self-contained housing (in Use Class C3), subject to relevant development plan policy criteria for mixed-use development.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
